doc.title: Carl Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, Georgia, January 4, 2013

title: Louis Hayes in Paris with Cannonball: even the kids speak French
summary: Allen urges Rowe to talk to Louis Hayes, then tells the story of Hayes's first trip to Europe with Cannonball.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Yeah, sure. We don’t want to solve the debate.
We’ve got to leave some mystery.
Yeah, yeah. If you ever get a moment, you’ve got to talk to Louis Hayes, though.

He’s a character. You know, I’ve got to tell you a funny story. This was the first time he went to Europe with Cannonball. They were in Paris. And they’d meet in the lobby for a sound check, and there’s no Louis. And they’re waiting around for Louis. So here he comes, after they’d been waiting about twenty minutes. He comes in the hotel and he’s just shaking his hands like — ooo. They said, “Louis, man, where you been? We’ve been waiting for you.” He said, “man, I went to take a walk, man, it’s incredible man.” They said, “What?” He said, “You won’t believe how smart the kids are here.” And they go, “What are you talking about?” “Even the kids speak French.” My man Lou.
